decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm’s established spraying know-how, and with strong in-house R&D and university links the firm is likely to learn and refine this niche system rather than withdraw it quickly.
A low-pressure injection pump is close to the core product base, so the firm has high absorptive capacity to interpret early market feedback and improve it, making continuation likely.
This product line with several models clearly extends existing pump and material-handling capabilities, and such a broad committed launch is unlikely to be removed soon in a growing market.

Although somewhat more system-oriented, it still builds on the firm’s established application equipment and fits its move toward interoperable customer solutions, so its knowledge base supports keeping it on the market.
